name: WNBA_R1B3_FAILURE_CLOSURE_AND_PLATT_FEASIBILITY_V1

feasibility_input.raw_signal: p_win_selected_side from the frozen R1A6 probability rowset
feasibility_input.binary_outcome: selectedSideOutcome from the frozen R1B2 scored rowset
feasibility_input.reason: The fallback base signal failed the preregistered raw probability calibration gates and no WNBA Elite selection gate has been certified.

runtime_engine_use.runtime_note: The PR #671 validator does not inspect sportEliteGatePassed at runtime. Feasibility rows deliberately carry sportEliteGatePassed=false; acceptance by the mathematical functions must not be interpreted as contract certification.

rolling_origin.training_rule: For each target season, fit only rows from seasons strictly earlier than the target season.
rolling_origin.2021_role: training seed only in this feasibility run

feasibility_outputs.calibrated_rowset: Only target folds 2022-2025; 2021 receives no calibrated probability because no prior-season fit exists.

predeclared_feasibility_interpretation.promising: Calibrated pooled Brier, log loss and ECE10 are each no worse than raw pooled values, with at least Brier and log loss strictly improved.
predeclared_feasibility_interpretation.not_promising: Any of pooled Brier or pooled log loss worsens, or pooled ECE10 worsens.
